goals.title: Find prematch flag texture source
goals.description: Verified SELECT code uploads two 64×28 flags from RAM 0x800CC600 and 0x800CC980 in one 64×56 GPU transfer (560,0), at PC 0x80092F38 / 0x8009310C. Original loader ID 5 stages stadium GDC data at RAM 0x800C8000, overlapping those flag buffers at +0x4600. Research the last writer and load/copy ordering; do not infer source from matching colors or static VRAM snapshots.
